skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature of logistics and logistics management in business.
Identify and explain the characteristics and activities of logistics and logistics management in businesses.
Classify logistics activities in businesses and recognize, solve decisions in customer service management.
Manage inventory and recognize, solve decisions in inventory management.
Manage transportation and recognize, solve decisions in transportation management.
Manage warehousing and recognize, solve decisions in warehousing management.
Manage packaging and recognize, solve decisions in packaging management.
Manage reverse logistics and recognize, solve decisions in reverse logistics management.
Demonstrate self-reliance when working independently and show personal responsibility and responsibility towards group work.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve logistics and supply chain problems.
Work effectively in teams and demonstrate collaborative skills.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on logistics and supply chain topics.
